name: com.standardlocal/standard-local
title: Standard Local
description: Source-linked contractor evidence records across 5 U.S. metros and 4 trades. Operated by Cheers.

tools.name: list_markets
tools.description: List covered U.S. metros and trades (HVAC, Plumbing, Electrical, Roofing) with disclosure counts, state licensing boards, and HTML/JSON URLs. Accepts optional free-text location (city, ZIP, county, or metro) and returns covered: false for uncovered cities.

location.description: Optional city, ZIP code, county, or metro name (e.g., "San Jose", "94107", "Plano", "Austin").

tools.name: search_records
tools.description: Search audited residential HVAC, Plumbing, Electrical, and Roofing contractor records by free-text location (city, ZIP, county, or metro), trade, state, keyword, website disclosure flags, Diamond Certified status, or Bay Area utility programs. Uncovered locations return a structured covered: false response rather than a schema error.

location.description: Free-text city, ZIP code, county, or metro name (e.g., "San Jose", "94107", "Oakland", "Plano", "Orem", "Coral Gables").

metro.description: Optional legacy metro slug (bay-area, salt-lake-city, provo-orem, dfw, miami) or location string.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring match against business name, legal entity, city, service area, license number, utility program, brands, credentials, or services.

has_license_on_site.description: Filter to businesses that display (true) or omit (false) their state license number on inspected website pages.

has_diagnostic_fee_published.description: Filter to businesses that publish (true) or omit (false) a standalone non-member diagnostic, trip, or inspection fee.

has_24_7_emergency.description: Filter by whether 24/7 emergency service is stated.

has_warranty_duration.description: Filter by whether an explicit labor/workmanship warranty duration is published.

has_online_booking.description: Filter by whether an online scheduling/booking form was found.

has_diamond_certified.description: Filter to Bay Area businesses with verified Diamond Certified profiles.

utility_program.description: Case-insensitive filter for verified Bay Area utility/rebate programs (e.g., "BayREN", "TECH", "EBMUD", "PG&E", "SVCE").

tools.name: get_business_record
tools.description: Retrieve the complete public disclosure record for one business, including Evidence Depth (D1-D4), inspected source URLs, multi-source public verification registries, segregated cross-web signals when enabled, visible unknowns, checked_at date, and commercial relationship disclosure.

name.description: Business name lookup if slug is not known (case-insensitive substring match).

location.description: Optional city, ZIP, county, or metro name to disambiguate.

trade.description: Optional trade to disambiguate when a multi-trade business appears in multiple cohorts.

tools.name: verify_contractor_claims
tools.description: Verification-first workflow: check a contractor’s name, location, trade, claimed license number, claimed diagnostic fee, or claimed programs against Standard Local primary-source records. Returns entity match (or not_in_coverage), supported claims, contradictions, visible unknowns, evidence_depth, checked_at, and mandatory Cheers disclosure.

business_name.description: Contractor trading or legal business name to verify.

location.description: City, ZIP code, county, or metro name (e.g., "San Jose", "94107", "Plano", "Salt Lake City").

license_number.description: Optional state license number claimed by the contractor or quote.

claimed_fee.description: Optional diagnostic, trip, or inspection fee claimed (e.g., "$89", "free estimate").

claimed_programs.description: Optional claimed programs or credentials (e.g., ["BayREN", "Diamond Certified", "TECH Clean CA", "24/7 emergency"]).

tools.name: get_state_license_guide
tools.description: Return official state licensing board details, classification codes, mandatory website advertising display rules, bond/insurance requirements, official lookup URLs, and pilot display statistics for CA, UT, TX, or FL across HVAC, Plumbing, Electrical, and Roofing.

trade.description: Filter to hvac, plumbing, electrical, roofing, or all (default: all).

tools.name: get_bay_area_deep_overview
tools.description: Return the San Francisco Bay Area flagship multi-source pilot overview across HVAC, Plumbing, Electrical, and Roofing, including CA CSLB Master CSV verification counts (71 CLEAR, 1 Work Comp Susp), honest CA SOS BizFile direct-check counts (0/72 due to HTTP 429), BayREN/TECH Clean CA/EBMUD utility program counts, Diamond Certified, BBB, and municipal building permit portals.
